milestone: M5.3 Form row-local typed choices and shared option occurrences

inheritance.resolver: Inherit every original symbol, option, dynamic path and unclosed owner obligation through immutable M5.2 evidence and the original audit. This selected Form option delta neither replaces prior ledgers nor reruns or recertifies historical runtime.

public_delta.note: Use three small private option DOM/raw-map, raw-selection and occurrence-availability functions in the existing row-options owner at Form/Grid/List callers. Existing binders retain caches, rules, drafts, errors and lifetimes. No typed-mode option, local-source API, registry, separate binder or public utility.

typed_form.outcome: Recognize all required row-local option markers only on Rows-backed Form Select fields. Prepare safe nested label/value paths, authored nodes and raw values; generate textContent options through existing rowOptions. Reject missing/unsupported markers, marked local Forms and typed-choice string parsers before ownership. Preserve every unmarked/local scalar-parser contract.
typed_form.remaining: Wider Form raw rendering, bind-value transformations and full control/callback/dynamic workflows stay required.

identity_occurrences.outcome: Use Object.is for string/number/boolean/null values, including signed zero. Single selection chooses the first match; multiple selection consumes one option per requested occurrence and reads in DOM order. Availability consumes the same counts: [1,1] requires two raw-1 choices. Apply the same actual functions to Form/Grid/List and full Grid paste validation; no serialized HTML value determines raw identity.
identity_occurrences.remaining: Standalone Select public behavior stays unchanged. No generic collection, normalization or selection engine is introduced.

validation.outcome: Keep typed-choice integrity mandatory with autoValidate:false. Unmapped/foreign or disabled selected options remain invalid drafts without undefined writes. Validate each target row against its own candidate/source without visible-row map leakage or DOM changes. Null needs a real null option; full required validation rejects null/empty scalar and empty arrays while [null] or [empty string] can represent actual multiple choices. Preserve disabled/custom-validity and business-rule boundaries.
validation.remaining: Legacy unvalidated paste and broader validation-scope equivalence remain open. Ordinary unmarked Form choices retain their existing application parsing boundary.

lifecycle.outcome: Prepare all marked fields before changing direct-bind identity or option DOM, so a malformed later field preserves the prior binding. Cache source identity; preserve raw drafts when options change. Stop stale later-field work after callback reentry/replacement/rebinding/disposal with a Form-owned source/render guard. Null binding removes generated options without data writes. Restore exact authored nodes and initial selection on failure/disposal and release all claims/events/ARIA ownership quietly.
lifecycle.remaining: This does not claim complete callback lifecycle closure or introduce a generic rendering transaction.

detail.outcome: Use the existing full detail template row-option paths and remove manual option updates, code maps, numeric conversion and subscriber-order glue. Preserve the reduced template, shared Rows, CVC ownership, validation and existing native accessible HTML/CSS.
detail.remaining: Other authored screens and remaining UI/CVC workflows remain required; no second demo engine is added.

installed.outcome: Use one exact package in isolated JavaScript and TypeScript consumers and the same artifact in Chromium/Firefox/WebKit/actual Windows Chrome/Edge. Exercise marked Form typed choices and occurrence/integrity/restoration behavior through existing public APIs.
installed.remaining: No npm publication or release tag. Actual macOS/iOS Safari stays excluded; available WebKit is mandatory.
